name: Finset.card_powersetCard
type: {α : Type u} → (n : ℕ) → (s : Finset α) → (Finset.powersetCard n s).card = Nat.choose s.card n
provides: The number of n-element subsets of a finite set is the corresponding binomial coefficient.
